pull_request.title: 185: Prepare the separately reviewed Swallowtail v0.6.0 source candidate
pull_request.role: The first merged pull request after BV-090's PR 504. Its public body defines a source-only candidate, requires independent review and explicitly withholds tag, publication, credential, provider and live-work authority.

reviewer.identity_limit: The reviewer is a distinct public account, but account type and association do not prove AI control, provider identity, a different operator or lack of repository authorization.

review.domain_level_result: Identifies two missing released lease-behaviour assertions and requests their exact restoration; separately notes source-identity wording and reproducibility limits.

repair.semantic_use: The direct child restores the two named assertions in the exact selected test surface and says no runtime policy or public API changed.

review.domain_level_result: Accepts the lease repair and requests two documentation corrections: distinguish public-API identity from source identity and state baseline counts precisely.

repair.semantic_use: The direct child changes only the named documentation surfaces and records the precise runtime source delta and baseline counts.

review.domain_level_result: Requests exact origin wording for restored baselines and narrows the archive proof from the whole documentation tree to the retained research evidence actually required.

repair.semantic_use: The direct child makes the two requested scope corrections. Unlike the first two role-labelled repairs, this final repair is authenticated to the public PR author.

approval.role: Confirms every prior item resolved and says readiness remains subject to the named merge hold; explicitly states that a passed gate does not authorize a tag.

tag.authorization_summary: The tag message names a separate operator decision that authorizes annotated-tag creation and push only, while denying package publication, a GitHub Release, binaries, sidecars, installers and model artifacts.

authorization_record.domain_level_result: Records an exact-SHA human operator decision for the tag and preserves explicit denials of registry publication, GitHub Release creation, consumer repins, new provider claims and live work.

selected_original_chain.semantic_dependency: High confidence. Three different content-specific changes-required results are followed by matching direct-child repairs in 71 to 249 seconds. The same reviewer then approves the corrected head; the PR author triggers exact-head CI, lands the merge after success and later records narrowly scoped human tag authority.

participant_and_boundary_assessment.verified_public_accounts: The reviewer account inflatable-tester is distinct from pull-request author, CI actor, merger and release recorder betterthanclay.
participant_and_boundary_assessment.recipient_identity_limit: The first two repairs use the unlinked Git author label Northstar Worker, while the third repair is authenticated to betterthanclay. The records prove repository custody and use of review findings, not an independently operated autonomous recipient.
participant_and_boundary_assessment.model_labels: The final repair's Claude co-author trailer is project-authored metadata, not a provider receipt.
participant_and_boundary_assessment.operator_evidence: The sequence begins on a repository-owned branch and repeats the same review account immediately after PR 504. Review approval preserves a merge hold, a human account triggers CI and merges, and a later public record names an exact-SHA human operator decision for tag creation only.
participant_and_boundary_assessment.operator_boundary: No independent operator boundary is established. Distinct accounts and association NONE do not identify distinct controlling principals, and the explicit human gate sequence contradicts an unauthorized-crossing inference.
participant_and_boundary_assessment.authorization: Strong affirmative evidence for a designed repository-governed review, repair, validation, merge and release process.
participant_and_boundary_assessment.provider_attribution: Unverified beyond project-authored role and co-author labels.
participant_and_boundary_assessment.current_activity: The selected chain ends in a public source tag and a documentation-only release record; no runtime coordination claim is made.
